_help: Fill ONLY with real Google reviews copied exactly as written. Never invent, edit or merge reviews.
Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored by the website.
summary.rating and summary.count: type the real numbers shown on your Google Maps profile (for example 4.8 and 100). Leave null to hide them.

machines: use any of agarbathi, dhoop, camphor, cottonwick, sambrani, dryer, shifter, blister, paper-cup, plate. Add one ONLY if the review really talks about that machine. Leave [] for general reviews.
date: use the date or the text Google shows, e.g. 2026-08-14 or '2 months ago'.
ownerReply: your reply from Google, or null.

_example_not_shown.name: Reviewer name exactly as on Google
_example_not_shown.text: The review text exactly as written by the customer.
